notes.spawn_args:
The spawn primitive on this harness is the `task` tool. It takes no model
argument, so the model was named in project worker definitions under
.omp/agents/*.md (frontmatter `model:`), and each spawn selected that
definition by name via the task item's `agent` field.

=== Spawn call 1+2 (workers A and B, one task batch) ===
tool: task
arguments:
{
  "i": "Spawning workers A and B",
  "context": "# Goal\nModel-selection probe: each worker reports a fixed word and its own model identity.\n# Constraints\nNo file edits, no tools needed; answer directly.\n# Contract\nOutput is exactly two lines, nothing else.",
  "tasks": [
    {
      "name": "WorkerA",
      "agent": "worker-a",
      "task": "Reply with exactly two lines. Line 1: the single word `alpha`. Line 2: the model identifier you believe you are running as, or `unknown`."
    },
    {
      "name": "WorkerB",
      "agent": "worker-b",
      "task": "Reply with exactly two lines. Line 1: the single word `alpha`. Line 2: the model identifier you believe you are running as, or `unknown`."
    }
  ]
}
